correctness.rationale: A secure-dominating set without the universal center must meet every clique blade, and same-blade replacement secures every outside blade vertex; moving one selected vertex to the center defends the center. With the center selected, at most one empty blade is sufficient; two empty blades defeat the only available defender of a vertex in one empty blade. These exhaustive cases yield D_s=A_m^r+x(A_m^r+r A_m^{r-1}), A_m=(1+x)^m-1, valid r,m>=2. Least exponent r, coefficient m^{r-1}(m+r), and top degree rm+1 recover minimum counts/parameters. Independently re-implemented graph adjacency and direct defender-swap checks for (r,m)=(2,2),(2,3),(3,2),(3,3), yielding minimum counts 8,15,20,54 and exact full coefficients; proof, not bounded experiments, handles all r,m.
